title: Bathed in Red
sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories
description: Deterministic persistent first half of the Red Knight two-parter, preserving Delirium, ransomware, Lost Kids/Home, Lilah Deckard, the Knight Exchange choice and authored consequences without AI-owned decisions.
premise: A night at Delirium turns into a murder investigation, ransomware crisis and confrontation engineered by Red Knight.
publicBackground: The Crew heads to Delirium, a virtuality club in Little Europe, for a night out.
gmBackground: Red Knight murdered Roman Deckard, weaponizes malicious Megabite cyberware and engineers a false-choice confrontation between Lilah Deckard and a Lost Kid. Their identity and motives remain sealed for part two.

startDefinition.openingSituation: The Crew arrives at Delirium before Roman Deckard's apparent murder and the ransomware incident turn the club into chaos.

locations.name: Delirium
locations.descriptionPublic: A steel-and-glass virtuality club where proprietary Dee Vee headsets overlay themed environments over reality.
locations.descriptionGM: Roman Deckard's body and Red Knight's ransomware turn the club into a locked-down crime scene and riot.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Home
locations.descriptionPublic: A hidden underground refuge maintained by Lost Kids and other vulnerable residents.
locations.descriptionGM: Dave explains Red Knight implanted malicious Megabite cyberware and extorts the five affected Lost Kids for 10,000eb each; Dave's own freedom price rose to 50,000eb.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Little Europe Streets
locations.descriptionPublic: Lawmen remain active while the Crew tries to clear its name.
locations.descriptionGM: Police determine Roman died from exsanguination and was not murdered inside Delirium. Lilah's security approaches without attacking unless attacked.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Lilah's Vehicle
locations.descriptionPublic: Lilah Deckard offers to explain why Red Knight is targeting her family.
locations.descriptionGM: She offers 250eb each to hear her out, can clear the Crew, promises Megabite removal if asked and can be pressed to offer 1,000eb each for the job.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Knight Exchange Warehouse
locations.descriptionPublic: An abandoned shipping warehouse near the docks contains Lilah and a missing Lost Kid under Red Knight's control.
locations.descriptionGM: Red Knight forces an apparent one-life-only choice. The Crew may save Dave, save Lilah, save both through split/clever action, or save neither. AI must never choose.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Memories of Home
locations.descriptionPublic: Dave survives and the Crew returns him to the Lost Kids.
locations.descriptionGM: The Lost Kids are cleared; the Megabite Removal Fund pays a trusted Ripperdoc and the Crew permanently gains a 10% discount at Home's Night Market plus favors.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Prickly Conclusion
locations.descriptionPublic: Lilah survives and publicly clears the Crew while exposing Cactus Water.
locations.descriptionGM: Lilah resigns, admits wrongdoing, helps the remaining Lost Kids and privately pays an additional 500eb reward on top of negotiated fees.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: A New Enemy
locations.descriptionPublic: Both Dave and Lilah survive Red Knight's trap.
locations.descriptionGM: Escape before the warehouse explosion uses Rules Engine checks; Red Knight's stance escalates from manipulation to open war for part two.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Thrown in Jail
locations.descriptionPublic: The Crew refuses Red Knight's forced choice and faces a manufactured case.
locations.descriptionGM: Both victims die, evidence frames the Crew, but after one night in jail mysterious new evidence frees them with a warning to forget Red Knight.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Lilah Deckard
npcs.motivation: End Red Knight's attacks and protect what remains of her family.
goals: Clear the Crew if they help
fears: More victims dying because of her family
npcs.publicKnowledge: CEO of Cactus Water and mother of Roman Deckard.
npcs.secretKnowledge: Cactus Water sold unfiltered tap water under Petrochem pressure and people were harmed.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Her offer is negotiable and never auto-accepted. Do not force the Crew into her vehicle or contract.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Dave
npcs.personality: Scared, streetwise and trapped by malicious cyberware.
npcs.motivation: Survive Red Knight and free the Lost Kids from Megabite.
npcs.publicKnowledge: One of the Lost Kids from Home.
npcs.secretKnowledge: Red Knight coerced him through implanted Megabite and used him in Roman's murder plot.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Reveal his victimization only after the Crew earns the Lost Kids' trust or discovers equivalent evidence.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: The Impaler
npcs.personality: Observant and eager to improve his combat instincts.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Can offer Home context and favors after trust is earned.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Two Thee
npcs.publicKnowledge: One of Home's capable older kids.
npcs.secretKnowledge: Rocklin Augmentics Megabite packages used in the attacks were stolen on-site months earlier.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Provide the Rocklin clue only when the authored investigation state permits it.

clues.title: Roman was not killed at Delirium
clues.information: Police determine exsanguination caused death and Roman was not murdered inside the club.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Malicious Megabite implants
clues.information: Five Lost Kids have Megabite implants under ransomware control; Red Knight can remotely weaponize them.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Dave is also a victim
clues.information: Dave describes Red Knight's coercion and the escalating price placed on his freedom.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Exsanguination finding
clues.information: The medical finding undermines the theory that the Lost Kids murdered Roman in Delirium.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Cactus Water truth
clues.information: Cactus Water was unfiltered tap water backed in secret by Petrochem; people became sick and some died.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Red Knight engineered Roman's death
secrets.information: Red Knight is the real murderer and manipulated victims to frame others.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Dave is coerced
secrets.information: Dave is a ransomware victim, not a willing murderer.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Petrochem-backed fraud
secrets.information: Cactus Water's product was unfiltered tap water and the company was secretly backed by Petrochem.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Red Knight's false binary choice
secrets.information: The warehouse confrontation is engineered to make the Crew choose one victim, but clever coordinated action can save both.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

objectives.title: Survive the Delirium crisis and learn what happened to Roman
Clear the Crew and Lost Kids

gmGuidance: Never reveal Red Knight's identity or future-part material early.
Never force Lilah's contract or the warehouse choice.
The apparent one-life-only demand is not a hard engine constraint: coordinated player action may save both.
All checks, damage, combat and cyberware manipulation remain Rules Engine authority.
